title: Tiny, cute pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- left blade -->
  <polygon points='30,80 42,52 46,54' fill='#c8d8e8' stroke='#eef6ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- right blade -->
  <polygon points='70,80 58,52 54,54' fill='#aabdd1' stroke='#eef6ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- left handle -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='82' r='9' fill='#ff5a6e' stroke='#ffb3be' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='82' r='4.5' fill='#8c1d2e'/>
  <!-- right handle -->
  <circle cx='73' cy='82' r='9' fill='#ffa93b' stroke='#ffd79a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='82' r='4.5' fill='#8a4b00'/>
  <!-- pivot screw -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='3.5' fill='#ffe14d' stroke='#fff7b8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- screw slot -->
  <line x1='48' y1='53' x2='52' y2='53' stroke='#a67c00' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smiling face on blades -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='67' r='1.5' fill='#3b4b5e'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='67' r='1.5' fill='#3b4b5e'/>
  <path d='M46 71 Q50 74 54 71' fill='none' stroke='#3b4b5e' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='70' r='1.2' fill='#ff9aa6' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='70' r='1.2' fill='#ffb47a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- shine marks on blades -->
  <line x1='37' y1='62' x2='41' y2='55' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='63' y1='62' x2='59' y2='55' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
